scope_note: Question/proposed mechanism and signed result return reviewed. Proposed term is 180 days from effectiveness, subject to earlier repeal, modification or permanent standards. Paragraph 5 refers both to voter enactment and seven days after adoption. Exact operative interval, later implementation and measure/instrument link remain unresolved; this record does not add an in-force legacy moratorium.
title: Data Center Moratorium
wording: Shall an ordinance entitled "Town of Eliot Data Center Moratorium Ordinance" be enacted and furthermore direct the appropriate staff, boards and committees to prepare permanent land-use standards for data centers during the moratorium period.

scope_note: Question proposes permanent all-zone prohibition; counts visually reviewed. Referral, bindingness, passage rule, certification and operative legal effect remain unresolved.
wording: Are you in favor of amending the Town of Canterbury Zoning Ordinance to ban data centers?

scope_note: Official sample ballot asks enactment and describes a nominal May 2, 2027 endpoint (180 days), unless municipal officers extend or repeal. Signed return and secondary reported approval reviewed. Operative ordinance, applicability/effective dates, exemptions, passage rule and legal-force interval remain unresolved; no in-force legacy moratorium is added.
title: Temporary Moratorium on Data Centers in the Town of Sabattus, Maine
wording: Shall an ordinance entitled 'Temporary Moratorium on Data Centers in the Town of Sabattus, Maine' be enacted? If enacted, the Moratorium would remain in effect until May 2, 2027 (180 days), unless extended or repealed by the municipal officers.

scope_note: Question proposes a twelve-month permitting pause. Town-posted marked SAMPLE BALLOT counts visually reviewed. Planning Board signatures support proposal only. Referral, bindingness, passage rule, certification and operative legal effect remain unresolved.
wording: Shall the Town of Nottingham adopt a Temporary Moratorium on Data Centers Ordinance pursuant to RSA 674:23, which would prohibit the acceptance, processing, approval, or issuance of permits or approvals for the establishment, construction, expansion, or operation of data centers within the Town for a period of twelve (12) months, to allow the Town time to study potential impacts and develop appropriate zoning regulations?
